$doc: Draft-only prospect message templates. ALL assets are marked send=false. Operators must manually review, personalise, and send via their own authenticated channel. This module NEVER triggers external send, WhatsApp, SMS, or email dispatch.
$warning: NO SEND — draft templates only. Do not add runtime send capability to this file or the module that reads it.

acknowledgement.label: Acknowledgement
acknowledgement.body_template:
Hi {{first_name}},

Thank you for reaching out about {{product_label}}.

I've received your enquiry and will review your details today. I'll follow up with next steps within {{sla_hours}} hours.

Best,
{{operator_name}}
CorpFlowAI
acknowledgement.notes: Send within 24 h of intake. Personalise with business name and specific service interest.

qualification_outreach.label: Qualification Outreach
qualification_outreach.body_template:
Hi {{first_name}},

I'd love to understand your situation a bit better before we go further.

A few quick questions:
1. How are you currently generating leads / managing your website? (whatever is relevant to {{product_label}})
2. What's your primary goal in the next 3 months?
3. Are you the right person to discuss this, or should I copy someone else?

Happy to jump on a quick call if easier — just reply here.

{{operator_name}}
qualification_outreach.notes: Use when prospect has not responded to acknowledgement or when qualification fields are incomplete.

discovery_invite.label: Discovery Call Invite
discovery_invite.notes: Use after qualification criteria met. Confirm the booking in the system after prospect responds.

follow_up_no_response.label: Follow-up (No Response)
follow_up_no_response.body_template:
Hi {{first_name}},

Just following up on my message from {{days_ago}} days ago about {{product_label}}.

I know things get busy — if now isn't the right time, no problem at all. Just let me know.

If you'd still like to explore, I'd be happy to find 15 minutes this week.

{{operator_name}}
follow_up_no_response.notes: Use at day 3, 7, 14 after no response. After follow_up #4 with no response, move to stalled or lost.

nurture_value_share.label: Nurture — Value Share
nurture_value_share.notes: Use for stalled prospects during the 90-day reactivation window. Personalise value_content with a specific insight, case result, or relevant article. Not a sales pitch.

objection_response.label: Objection Response
objection_response.channel_hint: match the channel where the objection was raised
objection_response.body_template:
Hi {{first_name}},

Thank you for sharing that — I hear you on {{objection_summary}}.

{{objection_response_content}}

The way I see it: {{reframe}}.

Would it help to adjust the proposal? I can {{adjustment_offer}}.

Let me know what makes sense.

{{operator_name}}
objection_response.notes: Operators must personalise every field. Common objections: price, timing, uncertainty about ROI. Never over-promise or guarantee revenue outcomes.

proposal_handoff.label: Proposal Handoff
proposal_handoff.channel_hint: email preferred for formal proposals; whatsapp summary acceptable
proposal_handoff.notes: Review full proposal against pricing guide before sending. Do not include revenue guarantees. Operator must approve before sending.

lost_close.label: Lost — Graceful Close
lost_close.body_template:
Hi {{first_name}},

I wanted to close the loop on our conversation about {{product_label}} for {{business_name}}.

No hard feelings — I understand the timing or fit wasn't right.

If circumstances change down the line, feel free to reach out. I'll keep {{business_name}} in mind if something relevant comes up on our end.

Wishing you well,
{{operator_name}}
lost_close.notes: Send only when prospect has explicitly declined or when follow-up cadence is exhausted. Keeps the relationship positive.

stalled_check_in.label: Stalled — Check-In
stalled_check_in.body_template:
Hi {{first_name}},

It's been a while since we spoke — hope things are going well at {{business_name}}.

I wanted to check in and see if {{blocker_reason}} has resolved or if there's a better time to pick up our conversation.

No obligation — just didn't want to lose touch.

{{operator_name}}
stalled_check_in.notes: Use at 30-day intervals during stalled period. If no response after 90 days from last activity, move to lost.

reactivation.label: Reactivation
reactivation.subject_template: Re: {{business_name}} — ready to pick this up?
reactivation.body_template:
Hi {{first_name}},

I hope things have moved forward at {{business_name}} since we last spoke.

We've {{since_last_contact_update}} — I think the timing might be better now for what you were looking at.

Would you like to revisit? Happy to start fresh with a 15-minute call.

{{operator_name}}
reactivation.notes: Use when reactivation_due signal fires or prospect re-engages. Update 'since_last_contact_update' with a specific recent improvement or result.
